column1: Methodology of Köppen-Geiger-Photovoltaic climate classification and implications to Worldwide Mapping of PV System Performance
Worldwide mapping of KGPV scheme and performance of PV system with typical c-Si PV modules.
Parameters used: Kross=0.03 °C m2/W, gama=-0.45 %/°C, nBOS= 85%
H_eff: Annual Effective Irradiation at Plane-of-Array [kWh/m2]
Tamb_avg: Annual average module operating temperature [°C]
Tmod_max: Annual maximal module operating temperature [°C]
Tilt: Optimal tilt angle for fixed mounting [°].
